newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PT Kedawung Setia signs $25 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: PT Kedawung Setia signs $25 mln loan.

text.p: A US$25 million loan and revolving credit facility has been completed for PT Kedawung Setia Industrial Ltd and PT Kedawung Setia Corrugated Carton Box Industrial Ltd, lead manager Sanwa Bank said.
Tranche A is a US$15 million revolving credit. It has a final maturity of two years with a lenders' extension option for another three years.
Tranche B is a US$10 million term loan facility. It has a final maturity of three years with a lenders' extension option for another two years.
Banque Nationale de Paris, Singapore, is arranger and lead manager.
Sanwa Bank Singapore, Creditanstalt-Bankverein, Singapore and Fuji Bank Singapore are co-arrangers and lead managers.
Bank BNP Lippo Indonesia is a lead manager.
